title: Strengthen planning decision evidence and publish provisional results
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's instruction to proceed with the five prioritized tasks: establish evaluation criteria and accountable decision roles; deepen HPCI lifecycle and operational evidence; improve the public procurement and five-year TCO evidence model; improve EEA1 common-benchmark reproducibility; and connect application needs to system requirements and planning options. Use public information only, preserve unknowns as Coverage Gaps, leave weights, pass/fail thresholds, scores, budgets and quantities unset without human approval, keep Consensus incomplete because one model and one agent perform this round, publish the provisional results to GitHub Pages through a pull request against main, and do not merge without a separate explicit instruction.
